description: Estimate what a small business is worth using Normalised EBITDA and typical small-business earnings multiples. Answers "how much is my business worth?" from real figures — revenue, cost of goods sold, operating expenses, owner pay and a fair-market salary for the owner role — rather than a generic rule of thumb. Produces an indicative enterprise value range, not a professional appraisal.

fairMarketSalary.description: What it would cost to hire someone to do the owner role.

operatingExpenses.description: Annual operating expenses, excluding owner pay.

ownerPay.description: Total owner compensation taken from the business.

name: forge_business_valuation_estimate
